parrafo_1.es: CJ Ceramic Tile es el trabajo de Chris Johnson, instalador de tile en Tallahassee especializado en remodelación de baños, duchas a medida y pisos. Chris atiende cada proyecto en persona, de principio a fin.
parrafo_1.en: CJ Ceramic Tile is the work of Chris Johnson, a tile installer in Tallahassee specializing in bathroom remodels, custom showers and flooring. Chris handles every project in person, from start to finish.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes en Google destacan lo mismo una y otra vez: paciencia ante problemas inesperados, cortes precisos alrededor de molduras y ventanas, y un trabajo terminado que supera lo esperado.
parrafo_2.en: Clients on Google point to the same things again and again: patience through unexpected problems, precise cuts around trim and windows, and finished work that exceeds expectations.

texto.es: Nos cuentas qué necesitas (baño, cocina, piso) y Chris responde por teléfono o mensaje de texto.
texto.en: Tell us what you need (bathroom, kitchen, flooring) and Chris responds by phone or text.

texto.es: Chris revisa el espacio en persona y te da un presupuesto claro, sin compromiso.
texto.en: Chris checks the space in person and gives you a clear estimate, no strings attached.

texto.es: Tile, cortes y acabados hechos con calma y precisión, avisándote de cualquier imprevisto antes de que sea un problema.
texto.en: Tile, cuts and finishes done carefully and precisely, with any surprise flagged before it becomes a problem.

texto.es: Revisas el resultado terminado con Chris antes de que se considere el trabajo cerrado.
texto.en: You walk through the finished result with Chris before the job is considered done.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el proyecto. Llámanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the project. Call us and we will walk you through the price, no strings attached.

texto.es: Retilado completo de baño, incluyendo tina a ducha, vanidades y acabados, con el mismo cuidado que describen las reseñas de Chris.
texto.en: Full bathroom retiling, including tub-to-shower conversions, vanities and finishes, with the same care clients describe in Chris's reviews.

texto.es: Duchas con nichos empotrados, bordes decorativos y cortes de precisión de piso a techo.
texto.en: Showers with built-in niches, decorative borders and precision cuts from floor to ceiling.

texto.es: Patrones a medida con cortes intrincados alrededor de molduras y tomacorrientes.
texto.en: Custom patterns with intricate cuts around trim and outlets.

texto.es: Porcelanato tipo madera y pisos de área amplia instalados nivelados y sin huecos.
texto.en: Wood-look porcelain and large-format flooring installed level and gap-free.

pie.es: ¿No ves lo que buscas? Llámanos igual, Chris te dice si puede ayudar.
pie.en: Do not see what you need? Call anyway, Chris will tell you if he can help.

items.quote: We needed to have our master bathroom remodeled and retiled. Chris J came to us highly recommended. His reputation is very well deserved. He did a beautiful job, and he did it on budget... His professionalism and attention to detail makes him one of the finest craftsman we have ever had the privilege to deal with.

What an amazing bathroom transformation by Chris Johnson at CJ Ceramic Tile. The finished product exceeded my original expectations. Chris's skill, workmanship, and pride in his work showed throughout the process... My thanks goes out to Chris for his professionalism and a job well done.

Chris did a beautiful job on backsplash in our kitchen. The cuts around the wood trim were very small and intricate. Chris takes a lot of pride in doing his work the right way. He's a craftsman. Get him to do your job if you can.
